entries.what: Letter shapes (E, I, O, F) are carved around the glowing gear ring behind Indio.
entries.where: top-left and top-right of the gear halo

entries.what: A second bare forearm ending in a hand with a red bow hangs on the same side of his body as the arm holding the phone, so it can belong to neither shoulder.
entries.where: lower right, below the phone arm

entries.what: Bea on the phone screen has black hair and no glasses, while the very next shot gives her a brown bob and round glasses.
Orange block letters stand on the newsroom shelf behind her.
entries.second: confirmed; must_fix corrected to true: the orange letters read as 'INA' at full size, so they show on a paused phone

entries.what: The boat's bamboo booms cross in an X in front of Indio and attach to nothing.
M's far hand has long thin boneless fingers that trail off into loose strands.
entries.where: M's raised hand, centre of frame
entries.second: confirmed; must_fix corrected to false: at 5x the far fingertips are muddy and run into the crescent's hanging cord, but at full size the hand is small and reads as a normal cupped hand

entries.what: The seated woman at the left has a flat fingerless mitten where her hand should be.
Indio's skin is ivory pale and his face longer and sharper than his warm brown look in the other shots.
Letter shapes (E, I, O, D) are carved around the stone dial instead of plain notches.
entries.where: dial rim, left of the hand

entries.what: The man touching the dial has long loose hair, pale skin and neither the red headband nor the topknot Indio wears in every other shot.
entries.where: upper half of frame, his head

entries.what: An extra rounded fingertip with its own outline is fused to the side of the ring finger.
entries.where: ring finger, upper right of the hand

entries.what: The shot is drawn as two full-length figures standing on a blank white void, like a character sheet, while the shots around it are the painted cave.
Their clasped hands merge into one lump with no separable fingers.
Usman is a stocky dog with a grizzled grey muzzle and both ears folded, not the slim black street dog with one upright ear of the other shots.
Three separate hands reach in to fit the stones although only Indio is moving in the frozen cave.
entries.where: from the left, the top and the right edge

entries.what: The very old woman of the cave is drawn here as a white-bearded old man.
M wears Indio's beige fur coat and red waist sash instead of her long dark coat.
Oars cross the boat held by nobody and one loose blade stands in mid-air in front of Indio.
A second red kerchief grows out of the shoulder and sleeve of his grey shirt, besides the one on his wrist.
entries.where: his left shoulder, right of frame

entries.what: A closed eye with lashes is drawn on the blank notebook page, attached to nothing.
The notebook is a photographic image with real paper and gold paint, not the episode's cel-shaded anime.
The yeti on the ridge is a round smiling cartoon snow creature, not the ape-like white-furred giant of the earlier shots.
Letter shapes (O, N, H) are carved in a band on the door lintel.
entries.where: lintel above the door, right of centre

entries.what: The book is a photo-like image with real leather and paper texture and a blurred photographic background, not the episode's cel-shaded anime.
A row of letter-like marks runs along the building's front in the cover drawing.
entries.where: centre right, under the balcony of the drawn building

entries.what: The red kerchief on his wrist is covered in black letter-like marks.
entries.where: kerchief on his raised wrist, left of centre

entries.what: M has warm brown skin here, while in the cave and boat shots her skin is pale.
The old woman of the cave has short loose grey hair and a different, heavily wrinkled face, while shot 26 gives her two long grey braids.
entries.where: her head, left half of frame

entries.what: A hand holding the stone dial comes out of the old man's beard with no arm leading to it.
entries.where: right edge of the dial, beside the beard

entries.what: The wall maps carry small letter-like marks in a label box and in lines of legend text.
The prayer flags are covered in rows of letter-like marks.
entries.where: flag line along the wall, upper left

entries.what: The paper and open book in the old woman's hands show lines of letter-like marks.
